SDCD1.label: Close delete account

SDCD1.1.label: Request to close/delete account
SDCD1.1.description: Definition: Use when the customer explicitly asks to close or permanently delete an account.

SDCD1.2.label: Not enough info
SDCD1.2.description: Definition: Use when account closure is mentioned but the requested action is unclear.

SDCD1.3.label: Other
SDCD1.3.description: Definition: Use for another issue preventing or affecting account deletion.

SDCD1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified as 'Close delete account'. Choose the root cause from this group only. That contact reason means: Use when the primary request is to close or permanently delete a user account, or when account deletion cannot be completed, and not for unsubscribing, changing details or removing a specific item of personal data.
